ranked.headline: Real-time QEC decoders extend to qLDPC codes via parallel BP, GPUs and predecoding
ranked.summary: SCOPE reports 173.8 ns latency on a BB code as BP variants, GPU decoders and MWPM speedups target real-time qLDPC and surface-code decoding.

ranked.headline: Symmetry probes of altermagnets and Berry-phase magnon transport take shape in theory
ranked.summary: New preprints propose optical, nonlinear-spin and magnon-transport probes of altermagnets, chiral order and orbital magnetism, all at the theory level.

ranked.headline: ML and empirical models map galaxies, gas and mass onto dark-matter-only simulations
ranked.summary: Several preprints build learned or empirical mappings from N-body halos to galaxies, tSZ maps and mass maps, aimed at survey-scale forward modelling.

ranked.headline: Channel exceptional points and correlation structure shape open and monitored quantum dynamics
ranked.summary: New preprints use channel-level exceptional points, ensemble transitions and Gaussian ergotropy to probe correlations under dissipation and measurement.

ranked.headline: DESI-era fits and reconstructions test scalar-field dark energy and phantom crossing
ranked.summary: DESI-based fits and non-parametric reconstructions test evolving dark energy, with a reported phantom-divide crossing near z≈0.5–0.7.

ranked.headline: Training and readout strategies for variational circuits and quantum reservoirs, mostly at classical parity
ranked.summary: Seven preprints probe optimizer, measurement-cost, and input-encoding choices in variational and reservoir quantum learning, with several reporting classical parity.

ranked.headline: Code and circuit distance are being optimized and certified for hardware-constrained qLDPC and color codes
ranked.summary: Six preprints tie code design to hardware-level fault distance, via scheduling, flags, exact certification, and cultivation analysis.

ranked.headline: Entanglement, symmetry breaking and topology in open and driven quantum many-body dynamics
ranked.summary: Six preprints tie long-time and nonequilibrium dynamics to hidden correlations, symmetry asymmetry and quantum resources across circuits, mixed states and Hamiltonians.

ranked.headline: Thermodynamic and control frameworks for engineered many-body quantum and phononic systems
ranked.summary: Six November 2026 preprints apply thermodynamic, non-Hermitian and control-theoretic tools to steady states, thermometry, heat engines and driven phonon dynamics.

ranked.headline: Compilers, decoders, and control hardware are being co-designed for neutral-atom, ion, and fault-tolerant platforms
ranked.summary: Six preprints target the classical stack, covering FPGA control, compilation, and decoder evaluation, which sets latency and fidelity on neutral-atom and trapped-ion hardware.

ranked.headline: Rydberg simulators and gates advance alongside fault-tolerance and control proposals for qubit platforms
ranked.summary: Preprints pair Rydberg phase estimation and finite-interaction CCZ gates with fault-tolerant T-gate and many-body control schemes.

ranked.headline: Disorder and scattering are treated explicitly in topological, orbital and Weyl transport
ranked.summary: Preprints treat layer-dependent disorder, Kubo-Bastin disorder averaging and non-constant relaxation times, plus a photonic mobility-edge demonstration.

ranked.headline: Optical and electrical pulses write skyrmions and switch compensated magnets deterministically
ranked.summary: Six preprints report picosecond optical writing of skyrmions, low-Gd all-optical switching, and electrical or probe-based access to compensated magnetic order.

ranked.headline: Magnetic and ferroelectric order electrically and optically tune valley excitons in 2D stacks
ranked.summary: Five preprints show magnetic proximity, optically programmed order, and sliding ferroelectricity controlling valley and exciton responses in van der Waals stacks.

ranked.headline: Euclid DR1 calibration chains for NIR imaging, astrometry, spectroscopy and ground-based colours are documented
ranked.summary: Five Euclid DR1 papers document the processing and calibration chains, with performance checked against requirements, ahead of scientific exploitation of the release.

ranked.headline: Euclid DR1 documentation sets out survey coverage, masks, photometry and photo-z processing
ranked.summary: Five Euclid DR1 papers appeared on 12 Nov 2026, documenting the release and validating photometry against JWST-based COSMOS2025.

ranked.headline: Resonance and material design in nanostructures tune hybridization, chirality, magnetization and THz coupling
ranked.summary: Five preprints report quantified gains from resonance engineering, including Q of 1083, circular dichroism of 0.995 and 145 dB THz dynamic range.

ranked.headline: Improved models and estimators extract more information from galaxy, lensing and 21-cm fields
ranked.summary: Five preprints refine redshift-space models, field-level likelihoods, lensing reconstruction and 21-cm bispectrum probes for extracting more from observables.

ranked.headline: Emulators and differentiable models extend nonlinear cosmological predictions toward LSST-era inference
ranked.summary: Five preprints in mid-November 2026 supply nonlinear, modified-gravity and field-level modeling tools for LSST Year 1 and DESI-class analyses.

ranked.headline: Dark-sector extensions and consistency tests probe dark energy, gravity and neutrino interactions
ranked.summary: Four preprints propose dark-sector models and model-independent consistency tests targeting cosmological tensions and degeneracies among dark components.

ranked.headline: Cross-spectra of 21 cm, Lyman-α and CMB lensing test EFT and halo-model predictions
ranked.summary: Simulation-based validation and forecasts for DESI and SPHEREx make cross-power measurements of these tracers testable now.

ranked.headline: Exact solutions and entanglement diagnostics in Kitaev-type and fragmented lattice models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend exactly solvable Kitaev-type and lattice models to non-Hermitian, hyperbolic, and fragmented settings.

ranked.headline: Parity and nonlocality govern bound states in the continuum in photonic structures
ranked.summary: Four recent preprints revisit accidental and topological bound states in the continuum across resonator, lattice and metasurface platforms.

ranked.headline: Tunable nonreciprocity and confinement in integrated and Floquet photonic platforms
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pursue nonreciprocal and strongly confined optical responses via 2D semiconductors, Floquet metasurfaces, magnonic cavities, and ENZ oxides.

ranked.headline: Programmable unitary photonics spanning coherent interconnects and optical computation
ranked.summary: Coherent detection and programmable unitary transforms are now being applied jointly to on-chip interconnects and optical neural networks.

ranked.headline: Josephson junctions engineered beyond the sinusoidal current-phase relation in qubit platforms
ranked.summary: Qubit designs now exploit higher-harmonic and non-ideal junction transport rather than assuming a sinusoidal current-phase relation.

ranked.headline: Wavelength-selective thermal radiation for solar absorbers and TPV emitters
ranked.summary: Recent numerical and proposal-stage studies extend spectral engineering of thermal radiation to absorbers, emitters, and property databases.

ranked.headline: Preserving and recovering optical structure under turbulence, quantization, and noise
ranked.summary: Four recent preprints target practical limits on structured optical fields, from turbulent transmission to reconstruction cost and measurement noise.

ranked.headline: Strain and gate fields tune valley, flat-band and superlattice states in graphene
ranked.summary: Three recent preprints show strain or gating reshaping graphene band structure to produce valley-selective, flat-band, and miniband states.

ranked.headline: Gold nano-pillar and multiple-quantum-well metasurfaces drive UV harmonic generation
ranked.summary: Resonant metasurfaces now push second and third harmonic generation into deep-UV, alongside quantum-well and integrated acousto-optic device modeling.

ranked.headline: Optical neural networks move toward weak supervision and function-level evaluation
ranked.summary: Three November 2026 preprints address training, evaluation, and reparametrization of optical neural network hardware.

ranked.headline: Superconducting phase coherence in confined and engineered quantum platforms
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report quantized superconducting transport, bosonic phase fluctuations in moiré graphene, and fermion-induced frustration in Josephson arrays.
